wave.prompt: Create a clean six-frame 2D pixel-art game sprite sheet based strictly on the MIDDLE STRIP of the reference: a RIGHT-facing breaking wave made of bright orange/red fire with TWO clearly readable East Asian dragons made of flame. One dragon's head rides the elevated curling lip and points slightly down-right, and the second dragon rides the leading foot close to the ground, pointing directly right. Both have the existing rounded Asian-dragon flame snouts, forked horns, whiskers, and eyes. They flow into one continuous traveling wave. The dark open hollow under the top curl is essential: two different levels clearly read, not two disconnected heads, and not a solid fireball. Red tails flowing left, vivid tangerine orange and amber flame crests, selected cream highlights, deep red and maroon shadows. Elevated top-down three-quarter wuxia game VFX, bright crisp chunky pixel clusters, readable at 146 x 48 native pixels, source art enlarged cleanly. EXACT sheet: 1536x1024, THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, 6 isolated effects. Each of the six equally sized 512x512 cells has the same wave, SAME footprint, SAME facing to the right, SAME front tip location around x=472 y=300 and same top dragon position relative to that tip. The whole wave uses about 440 pixels of horizontal space and about 180 of vertical space per 512 cell, with ample black margins on all sides. Each frame is a distinct adjacent phase of a smooth loop: change the curving lip and flame bands a little, let the trailing licks travel and peel off, and keep the two heads from flickering or moving position erratically. Preserve the reference's orange ridges and recognizable breaking-wave silhouette from frame one through frame six. Solid pure black #000000 background, no shadows on ground, no floor, no actors, no letters, no guide marks, no panel borders, no blur, no particle clutter, no bloom. One complete two-dragon breaking wave per cell, not cropped, no isolated body parts, no extra dragons. Reading order left to right top row then bottom row.
